```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

```

```{r}
s1_presentation_data <- readr::read_csv("s1_data.csv") |>
  mutate(experiment = "Experiment 1")
s2_presentation_data <- readr::read_csv("s2_data.csv") |>
  mutate(experiment = "Experiment 2")

combined_presentation_data <- bind_rows(s1_presentation_data, s2_presentation_data)
```

```{r}
comparisons_1 <- list(c("Low", "Medium"), c("Medium", "High"), c("Low", "High"))


s1_presentation_data %>%
    mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels=c("Low", "Medium", "High"))) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=Condition, y=mm_content_trust_combined_score, fill=experiment)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, alpha=0.6) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour=Condition), size=0.4, alpha=0.9) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position="none",
      plot.title = element_text(size=11)
    ) +
    ggtitle("Content Trust by Anthropomorphic Cue Condition") +
    xlab("Anthropomorphic Cue Condition") +
    ylab("Content Trust Score") + 
  # ylim(0, 10) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons_1,
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.signif",
      paired = FALSE
    )
```


```{r}
comparisons_2 <- list(c("Low", "High"))
s2_presentation_data %>%
    mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels=c("Low", "Medium", "High"))) %>%
  ggplot( aes(x=Condition, y=raw_content_trust_combined_score, fill=experiment)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
  geom_violin() +
    scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, alpha=0.6) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour=Condition), size=0.4, alpha=0.9) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position="none",
      plot.title = element_text(size=11)
    ) +
    ggtitle("Content Trust by Anthropomorphic Cue Condition") +
    xlab("Anthropomorphic Cue Condition") +
    ylab("Content Trust Score") + 
  ylim(0, 10) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons_2,
      method = "t.test",
      label = "p.signif",
      paired = FALSE
    ) 

```
